architecture.domain: Checked WeatherCoordinates, WeatherLocation and WeatherTemperature; persisted TemperatureUnit/WeatherPreferences; provider-neutral WeatherCondition and three consecutive checked WeatherDay values in WeatherSnapshot.
architecture.port: WeatherPort declares read-only legacy_preferences and forecast(checked coordinates, StopSignal). It owns contracts, not HTTP, files, renderer or desktop policy.
architecture.adapter: OpenMeteo implements WeatherPort. It owns bounded legacy-file reading, curl transport, provider-code/JSON/unit/date decoding and cooperative child-process cancellation.
architecture.root: The composition root injects OpenMeteo behind WeatherPort. DesktopSettings.weather and persistence::Persistence remain the sole settings authority and save path.
architecture.client: Weather child owns form/clipboard lifetime, panel motion/scroll, generations/coalescing, explicit commands, in-memory last-good/error/stale presentation. It returns save intent to the root and composes existing SDK elements/generated tokens.
architecture.framework: Existing TextFieldState/TextEdit, controlled ScrollSpec, Motion, surface instances, subscriptions and effects remain generic; no weather policy in Wayland, Vulkan, input or layout.
